checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implementation and verification complete: fixed overflowing loadout row, removed dead pasted combat code from drawEnemies, added hive/sentinel art, affix rings, beam telegraph and visuals, forceBossAffix seam; 69/69 tests, 5/5 gates, autoplay and boss-cycle probe OK; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-9' completed successfully.
[1/5] Plan: v0.10 Guardian update - Aegis Field skill, active-skill evolutions, Mortar/Widower/Husk mobs, WYRM mega boss

impact_assessment.why: The game has no defensive skill, actives cannot evolve while weapons can, the mob roster lacks artillery/slow/area-denial archetypes and the mega rotation repeats after two entries
impact_assessment.benefits: Fills the defense build gap, completes the evolution system, adds three distinct threat archetypes and a third mega fight
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot gains shield/slow fields and new enemy types; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: save schema unchanged, skills gain one key
impact_assessment.mitigation: Additive-only snapshot changes, reuse existing bomb/hazard/mega-phase machinery, full suite plus gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Implementation and verification complete: Aegis shield skill with Bastion combo, evolutions for blades/grenade/turret/aura, Mortar/Widower/Husk mobs with webs and acid pools, WYRM burrow/erupt mega boss, upgrades screen relaid out for 19 skills and 7 combos; 77/77 tests, 5/5 gates, 231s live probe and wyrm cycle probe OK; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-10' completed successfully.
[1/5] Plan: v0.11 Loadout update - offense/passive skill slot caps, armory Loadout Rig expansion, slot-aware level-up offers and HUD

impact_assessment.why: Runs can currently take all 19 skills, so builds converge and level-up choices lose meaning; the user asked for limits on skill number
impact_assessment.benefits: Creates build identity and real level-up tradeoffs, ties into existing armory metaprogression, keeps the 'everything caps at 5' contract
impact_assessment.risks: contract: level-up offers and applyUpgrade gain slot rules, snapshot gains slot fields; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: save.meta gains one additive key
impact_assessment.mitigation: Enforce in both offer generation and applyUpgrade, default missing meta keys to zero, full suite plus slot-specific tests and gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Implementation and verification complete: 6 offense + 6 defense skill slot caps enforced in offers, caches and applyUpgrade; Loadout Rig armory meta (+1/+1 per rank, 2 ranks); offer weighting toward owned skills; HUD, level-up card and setup slot displays; armory relaid out for 7 cards; 81/81 tests, 5/5 gates, 150s slot-discipline probe and save-compat probe OK; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-11' completed successfully.
[1/5] Plan: v0.12 Salvage update - boss salvage crates with 3-choice relic cards, 10 relic effects on existing stat hooks, snapshot mods/relics and grantRelic seam

impact_assessment.why: Builds are now slot-capped but every boss only pays loot and banking shards; there is no run-defining reward choice from the hardest fights
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a third progression axis that does not conflict with skill slots, makes boss kills a decision point and creates build variety across runs
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot gains relics/salvage/mods and a new screen; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: no save change (relics are per-run)
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep relics per-run only, reuse the level-up screen pattern, verify existing boss tests are unaffected, full suite and gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Implementation and verification complete: boss salvage crates with 3-card relic picker, 10 unique per-run relics wired to stat hooks, relic screen + world crate art, snapshot relics/salvage/mods, grantRelic and spawnSalvage seams; 86/86 tests, 5/5 gates, live crate-pick probe and 84s endurance probe with all 10 relics OK; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-12' completed successfully.
[1/5] Plan: v0.13 Boss Rush mode - mode selector at setup, boss-only progression with intermissions, 8-boss victory, mode-aware HUD and snapshot

impact_assessment.why: Every run is the same wave-survival loop; the eight boss fights are the highlight but arrive once every five waves, and there is no short-session or mastery mode
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a focused replayable mode that showcases the boss roster, gives short sessions a clear win condition and reuses existing boss, affix and relic systems
impact_assessment.risks: contract: setup and snapshot gain a mode field, run loop branches; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: no save-schema change, mode not persisted
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default mode stays survivors so all existing flows and tests are unchanged, gate boss spawn/kill paths behind G.mode, full suite and mode-specific tests before commit

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Implementation and verification complete: Boss Rush mode with setup selector, boss-only progression in fixed order with 14%/slot HP ramp and 40% affix chance, 4s intermissions with 30% heal, 8-boss victory, mode-aware HUD/snapshot; 88/88 tests, 5/5 gates, full rush-clear probe (42s, victory), rush relic pick probe and survivors regression probe OK; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-13' completed successfully.
[1/5] Plan: v0.14 Records and mastery - rush clears/best time, best wave, shield saves in save+stats, six achievements for relics/rush/wyrm/shield/slots, HUD relic readout, richer run summary

impact_assessment.why: New systems (relics, boss rush, aegis, slot caps, WYRM) have no achievements, records or on-screen presence outside their own screens, and the save's best-run fields only cover survivors
impact_assessment.benefits: Gives the shard economy new goals, makes mastery visible (rush times, best wave), surfaces relics during play and closes the loop on every v0.10-v0.13 feature
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save gains four additive fields and snapshot.save grows; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: additive save fields default to zero and are clamped on load
impact_assessment.mitigation: Additive schema with clamping and zero defaults, merge live stats the same way chests/hunters already do, add tests for legacy saves, full suite and gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Implementation and verification complete: rushClears/rushBest/bestWave/shieldSaves save fields with clamping, six new achievements (rush clear, sub-90s rush, 5 relics, WYRM, 10 shield saves, full loadout), live achievement checks from upgrades/relics, HUD relic readout, statistics record rows, mode-aware run summary; 93/93 tests, 5/5 gates, persistence probe (38.1s rush clear recorded and reloaded) OK; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-14' completed successfully.
[1/5] Plan: v0.15 Operators - five playable operators with distinct perks chosen at setup, perk hooks in HP/defense/velocity/crit/turret/aura/shard/relic-count, HUD and run summary display

impact_assessment.why: Every run starts from an identical baseline, so the newest systems (slots, relics, rush) vary but the character never does; no starting choice defines a run's identity
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a run-defining choice at deploy, gives the three specialists reasons to replay, and reuses existing stat hooks so no new content pipeline is needed
impact_assessment.risks: contract: setup and snapshot gain an operator field, relic offer count varies; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: no save change, operator is per-run and defaults to the baseline ranger
impact_assessment.mitigation: Baseline operator applies no modifiers so all existing balance tests are unchanged, gate perks behind one G.operator lookup, add per-operator tests plus a legacy regression run, full suite and gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Implementation and verification complete: five operators (ranger baseline, vanguard, marksman, engineer, scavenger) with perks on HP/damage-taken/velocity/crit/aura/turret-life/shards/relic-count, setup OPERATOR row with compacted bottom layout, HUD and summary display; 98/98 tests, 5/5 gates, setup overlap scan (31 buttons), all-operator 15s live runs and 4-vs-3 relic pick proof OK; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-15' completed successfully.
